description: List the districts of one city that have active listings. Returns each district's slug, name and escort and venue counts. Most cities have none: an empty list means search the whole city. Use a district slug as `district` in search_listings.

city.description: The city whose districts to list: its `slug` from list_cities (e.g. "berlin").

country.description: The city's `region` from list_cities: its country code, or its state code in a country the site splits by state (e.g. "US-CA").

name: list_districts

districts.description: Districts with active listings; empty when the city has none.

title: List districts
